Bug_Details:
Map#ofEntries will throw an IllegalArgumentException if there are any duplicate keys JDK 9 has
Map#ofEntries
factory which throws runtime error when provided multiple entries with the same
key. For eg, the following code is erroneously adding two entries with Foo as key. Map<String, String> map = Map.ofEntries(
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar"),
    Map.entry("Ping", "Pong"),
    Map.entry("Kit", "Kat"),
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar")); Map<String, String> map = Map.ofEntries(
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar"),
    Map.entry("Ping", "Pong"),
    Map.entry("Kit", "Kat"),
    Map.entry("Foo", "Bar"));
Bug_Explanation: The bug 'DuplicateMapKeys' is embedded in the code by adding multiple Map.entry calls with the same key ('Foo') to the Map.ofEntries method. This will cause an IllegalArgumentException to be thrown at runtime.
